**How to submit:** Draw and write on this page or on paper. Upload a clear photo to the university e-learning platform. Due: **before lecture 6**.
No task needs AI.

The scene, from the game *Lantern Keeper*:

| Line | Words of the scene |
|:---:|------------------------------------------------------------|
| 1 | EXT. LIGHTHOUSE ROCK – NIGHT. A storm hits the rock. |
| 2 | Mira climbs the wet stairs to the lighthouse door. |
| 3 | MIRA: The lamp is out. The ships can't see the rocks! |

## Task 1 · The beats

Each line is one beat. For each line, write what changes: the place, the
action, the speaker or a feeling.

**Line 1** \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ · **Line 2** \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ · **Line 3** \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

## Task 2 · Three panels

Draw one panel for each line, with simple shapes. Mira climbs from left to
right. Under each panel write the shot size, the action or the line, and the
time. Keep the same screen direction in all three panels.
